id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_095.pack|cs_:
"When Erdwin was about to deliver
  the final blow to the evil god, a voice
  crossed my mind.
"'Kill Erdwin, and I shall grant you power.'

"I steeled my heart against the honeyed
  words... but before I knew it,
  I had killed Erdwin.

"Absorbing the evil god's power and tainted
  by evil, I became Mordegon...

"But a faint trace of goodness remained
  in Mordegon. Another me was born.

"...Now that Mordegon is defeated,
  I give my final prophecy.

"The sage of time awaits the Luminary
  north of Yggdrasil. Borrow the Watchers'
  power and head there.

"...{var:1}.
  Please defeat the evil god
  and end this long war.

"Let's go, {var:1}. We've no time to waste.
  First, let's go meet the Watchers.

Veronica and Serena can now use the
team attack 'Cross Magic Burst'!
